purpose: Bounded source-only audit of IMU interval selection and sample-time integration semantics; no production behavior change or raw-data execution.

matlab_preprocessing.behavior: With no GNSS elapsed-time anchors, add the configured accel/gyro UTC offsets; synchronize on gyro by interpolating acceleration; compute forward dt=diff(sync_time) and repeat the final dt.

matlab_graph.behavior: For each GNSS interval select IMU samples inclusively (time >= t0 && time <= t1) and call integrateMeasurement with each selected sample's forward acc.dt; the source factor uses keyB2.

native_backend.behavior: The unchanged native loop skips samples before t0, excludes samples at t1, integrates each sample using dt=current_sample_time-previous_time, then holds the last included sample through the interval tail; it attaches the resulting preintegration to CombinedImuFactor.

source_contract.separate_concern: The source ImuFactor keyB2 versus native CombinedImuFactor/bias treatment was observed but not modified or conflated with this time-indexing audit. Phase197's -20 ms UTC-fallback correction is also separate and unchanged.

verification.gtsam_preintegration_control: The test feeds the test-local transcription's segments into gtsam::PreintegratedCombinedMeasurements and observes deltaTij=1.0 s and deltaVij.x=2.175 for the native schedule. This validates the GTSAM API call/duration, not a hidden backend trace.

interpretation.finding: The source and native schedules are measurably different at exact and between-sample GNSS boundaries. The source's inclusive endpoint plus forward dt can integrate beyond t1; the native loop preserves its current preceding-dt plus tail-hold behavior.
interpretation.highest_leverage_next_ablation: After a separately authorized real-data parity gate, expose/compare a source-inclusive-forward preintegration schedule against the current native schedule while holding IMU noise, UTC offset, bias random walk, factor family, and initialization fixed. No schedule change was made in Phase200.
limitations: The native backend loop was not refactored and no raw H/native solve was run; the schedule transcription and GTSAM preintegration call are synthetic diagnostics, not full-backend or accuracy evidence.
The bounded left-hold comparator is illustrative only and is not asserted to be the official MATLAB model.
No candidate, truth, MAT/PDC, precomputed-coordinate, Kaggle, or token payload was read; no accuracy claim is made.
